review.boundary_review: The strip at x<315 is the edge of facing fol. 54b. It shows 'Beng. ←' (y≈2360), '2 ←' (y≈3750) and '←' arrows (y≈3870, y≈4460), plus faint show-through marks such as '11' (y≈1840, y≈4250). These are not target text. On the target side of the gutter, the arrow at x≈415 (d.859 line) and the dashes at x≈330–480 (b.100 line) and x≈380 (d.1216(12) line) are recorded in the annotations of r015, r029 and r034. Their linkage to particular 54b notes is uncertain or probable only. b022 and b024 belong to the target page even though they cross the shelfmark column rule.

region_review.top: Only the folio number '55' appears above the first entry; the rest is blank ruled paper.
region_review.middle: All entries and cross-references from d.772(1) to Kokkoka are accounted for. Proposed corrections cover the interlinear 'y' (r011) and the cancelled Kaideva (r012).
region_review.bottom: d.1120, d.1216(12), the arrowed Śāradā formula, d.1056, c.299(3) and its faint incipit are all accounted for. Nothing appears below the incipit.
region_review.left_margin: Contains ticks, b022 and the scribe note b024, and gutter arrows and dashes. Facing-page fragments are excluded.
region_review.right_margin: Contains the struck c.383(6), the wrapped formula '6:Beng', and the overwritten line figures 16/19, 8/9, 9/12, 8/11 and 7/8.
region_review.interlinear: Contains [by Śaṅkarānanda], 'y', 'arī', 'with', 'ff.1-6', 'in two hands', and the 'k' insertions in Kokkoka and Kauṭilyāḥ. Small correction marks in the incipits are noted but not read.
